page.title: Request access
page.lead: The host will review your justification and attestations. You’ll see the decision on <link>your dashboard</link>.
page.auditableBody: Justification + attestations are stored as part of the dataset’s consent + DPIA record. Be specific — the host audits these later.

form.permittedBody: The host has tagged this dataset with the following GA4GH Data Use Ontology terms. Your intended use must be consistent with all of them.

project.titleHint: 5–200 characters. The host inbox renders this as the row title.
project.descriptionHint: 50–4000 characters. Cover the research question, the population, and how the data will be used.

intendedUse.hint: The platform auto-matches this against the dataset’s DUO terms. Conflicts get flagged for the host before approval.

NON_COMMERCIAL_RESEARCH.label: Non-commercial research
NON_COMMERCIAL_RESEARCH.hint: Academic / public benefit. Outputs may be published or shared open-source.

COMMERCIAL_RESEARCH.label: Commercial research
COMMERCIAL_RESEARCH.hint: For-profit research, including model training intended for commercial products.

CLINICAL_CARE.label: Clinical care
CLINICAL_CARE.hint: Direct use in clinical decision support / care pathways.

EDUCATION.label: Education
EDUCATION.hint: Teaching material; not for primary research outputs.

duo.hint: GA4GH Data Use Ontology — the terms whose conditions you agree to. Pick at least one that fits your project. The matcher is conservative on partial coverage.

compliance.irbApprovedBody: My institutional review board (or equivalent ethics committee) has approved this study.
compliance.irbRefHint: Optional. The IRB document or approval number we cite in the audit trail.
compliance.dpiaHint: Optional. The Data-Protection Impact Assessment for this use case.
compliance.retentionHint: How long you’ll retain the data after access ends. 1–3650 days (10 years max).

outputs.redistributionHint: What you’ll do with derived data, results, or model outputs.
outputs.outputTypeHint: The primary deliverable from this project.

builder.intro: For commercial / clinical-care intent we ask deployment-track questions so hosts can judge whether the proposed product fits their dataset’s licensing posture.
builder.whoPriorityHint: e.g. tuberculosis, maternal health, AMR. Leave blank if not applicable.
builder.accreditationsHint: e.g. WHO Innovation Hub, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, national MoH endorsement
builder.royaltyHint: LMIC public-sector terms welcome — hosts can negotiate clauses bilaterally.

action.disposableEmail: Requests from disposable email providers are not accepted ({domain}). Please use an institutional or organisational address.
action.apiBaseUrlMissing: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL not set in web env.

dashboard.title: My access requests
dashboard.lead: Restricted datasets you’ve asked to access. Hosts decide each request.
dashboard.emptyBody: Browse the <link>catalog</link> and submit a request from any RESTRICTED dataset’s detail page.
